cquarry-plugins 0.4.2: CARRIERS: v0.4.1 shipped with the root VERSION still reading 0.4.0 (the bump script updated pyproject and patchnotes but missed the VERSION file and pyproject), and the actions suite's version pin still asserted 0.4.0 -- the version-sync gate caught both, and the release went out anyway, which is exactly the failure mode the gate exists to prevent.

cquarry-plugins 0.4.1: ERRATUM for v0.4.0, whose CI ran red after the tag: the merge verb's fill/union fields plan through seven WriteGate methods (plan_set_authors, plan_add_tags, plan_set_languages, plan_set_rating, plan_set_pubdate, plan_set_publisher, plan_set_comments) that were written but left UNCOMMITTED in the host repo when v0.4.0 shipped, so every merge test failed on the released host (`plan_set_authors` missing).

cquarry-plugins 0.4.0: The find_duplicates actions land (Phase 2's actions half, contract 3): `merge --keeper ID --ids ID,ID [--fields ...]` carries calibre's merge behind the gates -- formats copied into the keeper's directory and registered (a format the keeper already carries stays), the chosen fields fill/union into the keeper (a conflicting identifier is reviewer-visible and never overwritten), and the absorbed rows are removed in the same one-batch transaction; the plan prints in BOTH modes (the plan is the record under --apply too, so a CONFLICT line is never invisible), and the file copies happen outside the batch.

cquarry-plugins 0.3.0: The find_duplicates port lands (Phase 2, the read half): the matcher ladder carried verbatim (identical / similar with the automerge strip / soundex with the adjustable per-field lengths / fuzzy with its aggressive reductions, the author reversal hashes, the ignore-word lists; the recorded tags-soundex length correction noted for the variations half), the three search types (title/author with the reversed-author hash, binary compare over the two-pass size-then-sha walk with an mtime-keyed sha cache in the plugin config, identifier exact-equality), the grouping pipeline with upstream's exemption partition (the don't-repartition subtlety ported with its comment), per-library exemptions stored in the plugin config under contract 2 (`exempt --books/--authors/--list/ --remove/--clear`; upstream's library-database prefs is the recorded storage substitution, keyed by the absolute library path), the cross-library mode (`search --against PATH`, report-only, no exemptions), and the group report as text or `--format json` in upstream's export shape (the recorded replacement for the GUI's marked-book highlighting).

cquarry-plugins 0.2.0: The extract_isbn port lands (Phase 1): the scanner (upstream's regex, strip passes, -10/-13 prefix handling, same-digit rejection, and validation order; the checksum formulas ported from calibre's check_isbn), the EPUB spine windows (stdlib zip + container.xml + OPF parsing under the EPUB_FILE_SCANS table), the PDF page windows (pdftotext + pdfinfo; the 100-byte near-empty extraction is the recorded encrypted/image-only decline), and the scan verb with upstream's failure classes carried: the dry run reports found / same / CONFLICT / none-found / no-format per book (a stored different ISBN is reviewer-visible, never auto-overwritten; the changed-ids line is pipe-ready) and the host's --apply writes through the WriteGate.
